# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

##### Our Footprint

Our footprint spans across Africa, where we are dedicated to advancing clinical and public health
outcomes through the strengthening of laboratory practice, scientific collaboration, and
professional networks.

We ensure that our impact reaches communities most in need. Our initiatives focus on capacity
building, training, and fostering innovation, creating a sustainable framework for improved health
services and scientific excellence throughout the continent.

### Our Areas of Expertise

 ASLM brings together programs, expertise, institutions and laboratory professionals to catalyse new
initiatives and processes toward improved laboratory capacity on the continent.

##### Our Footprint

Our footprint spans across Africa, where we are dedicated to advancing clinical and public health
outcomes through the strengthening of laboratory practice, scientific collaboration, and
professional networks.

We ensure that our impact reaches communities most in need. Our initiatives focus on capacity
building, training, and fostering innovation, creating a sustainable framework for improved health
services and scientific excellence throughout the continent.

[ Find out more ][72]

#### 1,300+

**laboratories** strengthened through quality assessments, proficiency testing, and training
programs.

#### 3,500+

**professionals** trained across AMR, genomics, laboratory quality, biosafety, and diagnostics.

#### 1.9 M

**downloads** of AJLM articles, reflecting extensive knowledge dissemination and influence.

# Stop managing systems. Start managing the business.

AvantiCoreX connects your systems, eliminates manual tasks and builds the foundation for your
company to operate with artificial intelligence. Without replacing everything. Without years-long
projects.

Most companies don't have a data problem. **They have a scattered-data problem.**

Calendar in one system. Finance in another. Contracts in a folder. Reports in a spreadsheet. And no
one knows where the latest version is.

AvantiCoreX exists to end this chaos and open the path for you to actually use AI.

[Book a Diagnostic][9][See How It Works][10]

Built and validated inside a real operation in São Paulo, Brazil

[AvantiCoreX Dashboard - Unified business view]

The problem nobody wants to own

## You pay for several systems. But none gives you a full view of the business.

It's not a lack of technology. You already have too much technology.

The problem is that each software solves one part, and none talks to the other.

1

### Calendar in one place, finance in another

You spend more time transferring data between systems than analyzing the business.

2

### Excel spreadsheet as a system

The spreadsheet is the glue holding everything together. And it breaks every week.

3

### Reports that arrive too late

By the time you finally have the numbers, the decision already needed to be made.

4

### Hours lost on repetitive tasks

Your team copies data, reconciles information and does the same manual task every day.

5

### AI you can't actually use

Everyone talks about artificial intelligence. But your data is too fragmented for AI to work.

6

### Decisions on guesswork

Without a reliable dashboard, you decide by what seems right, not by what the data shows.

And the worst part: the more the company grows, the worse it gets.

More processes, more systems, more spreadsheets. More rework, more errors, more time wasted.

Scaling the business without solving this is scaling the chaos.

In 2026, AI stopped being novelty and became a competitive advantage. Companies that organize their
data now will operate with AI in months. Those that don't will spend years trying to catch up.

But the problem is not the number of systems.
**It's the lack of a thread connecting them.**

AvantiCoreX solves exactly that.

[Recognize this scenario? Let's talk.][11]

How it works

## A journey from chaos to autopilot. At your own pace.

Before flying a fighter jet, you need the flight plan. AvantiCoreX guides every step, from
preparation to autopilot.

**You are the hero of this story.**

You built a business, hired a team and chose tools to help it grow. The problem is that those tools
grew in different directions, and no one connected them.

AvantiCoreX is not just another tool. We are the guide that helps you connect everything, automate
what is repetitive and build the foundation for AI to work for you.

The journey has five steps. You can start at any of them.

01

Flight Plan

1 to 2 weeks

### Operational Diagnostic

First, we understand where you are.

We map your systems, processes and bottlenecks. We identify where time is lost, where data gets
stuck and where the company is leaving money on the table.

Result:

A clear plan of where to start, without jargon, without endless proposals.

02

Terrain Recon

### System Integration

We connect what you already have.

Before buying anything new, we look at what already works. If your scheduling system can talk to
finance, we connect them. If there's duplicated data in three places, we unify it.

Result:

Data that flows automatically between your existing systems.

03

Aircraft Preparation

### ERP when needed

If a system needs to be replaced, we deploy the right one.

When integration is not enough, because the system is too old, too expensive or too limited, we
deploy a management platform built on top of one of the world's largest enterprise platforms, with
thousands of modules available. Main ones include finance, inventory, CRM, projects, HR, procurement
and sales, configured and customized to your business needs. Cloud-based. No infrastructure to

Result:

A solid, unified data foundation accessible from anywhere.

04

Takeoff

We eliminate repetitive work.

With organized data, we identify what can run on its own: approvals, notifications, reports, syncs,

What we offer

## Choose where to start. Scale at your pace.

Five services. One coherent journey. You decide the next step.

01

### Operational Diagnostic

Find out exactly where your company loses time and money, before investing in any solution.

Show summary
[Learn more][13]

Complete mapping of current systems and how they (don't) talk. Identification of the main
operational bottlenecks measured in hours/week and currency/month. Process analysis: which are
manual, which are already automated, which should be.

Imagine an operation with scheduling in one system, finance in another, and reports consolidated in
spreadsheets. The diagnostic maps where the team spends time on rework, quantifies the cost and
indicates which area to fix first.

The diagnostic becomes an executable plan: you decide whether to contract the next steps with us or
run it internally. No lock-in, no proposal packaged before understanding your scenario.

Ideal for SMBs of 5 to 50 employees that know they lose time and money on rework, but don't know
where to start solving it.

02

### System Integration

Your existing systems start talking to each other, no double data entry, no manual typing.

Show summary
[Learn more][14]

Mapping of systems to integrate and the data that needs to flow between them. Connection via
official APIs when available (absolute preference). Robotic process automation (RPA) when the system
has no API.

Customer places an order on the e-commerce, the financial system issues the invoice automatically,
inventory updates, the team gets notified on WhatsApp and the daily report consolidates everything.
No human intervention, no double entry, no parallel control spreadsheet.

We integrate with what's available in your current scenario, we don't force a proprietary stack. If
the system has API, we connect via API. If not, we evaluate RPA. If switching makes more sense, we
say so, without commercial bias.

Ideal for SMBs that already have systems running but lose time typing the same data in more than one
place.

03

### Cloud ERP

A complete management platform, in the cloud, configured for your sector, no infrastructure cost.

Show summary
[Learn more][15]

Deployment of main modules: finance, inventory, CRM, HR, procurement, sales, projects. Customization
for your vertical (healthcare, services, retail, legal, accounting). Data migration from existing
systems trying to preserve relevant history.

Imagine an operation with several systems in use, spreadsheets controlling critical processes and
reports consolidated manually every week. In a typical deployment, scheduling, finance, billing and
reports come to live in a single platform, with business KPIs visible in a dashboard.

We don't sell licenses that become your problem. We deploy, configure, train and accompany during
operation. When the ERP needs to evolve, you don't get stuck: our team knows your specific
configuration.

Ideal for SMBs with fragile or outdated systems, critical spreadsheets controlling processes, or an
under-utilized enterprise ERP that weighs more than it delivers.

04

### Process Automation

Repetitive tasks run themselves. Your team focuses on what no machine can do.

Show summary
[Learn more][16]

Mapping of repetitive processes with the highest team time consumption. Design of automated flows
(who does what, in what order, with what rules). Implementation of workflows (BPM, RPA or code,
depending on the case).

Customer pays an invoice → bank system detects → ERP marks invoice as paid → CRM updates customer
stage → sales team gets WhatsApp notification → daily collection report updates → thank-you email to
the customer. All automatic, in seconds, with no one typing anything.

We automate first what gives the highest return. The operational diagnostic already lists the
processes with the most impact. We don't sell volume of automations: we sell the ones that pay back
fastest.

Ideal for SMBs that already have reasonably organized systems and want to eliminate repetitive
operational work.

05

### AI Agents

AI that actually works in your business, because your data is ready for it.

Show summary
[Learn more][17]

Data readiness assessment (without organized data, AI has no foundation). Predictive analytics:
demand forecasting, financial risk, customer churn, inventory rupture. AI agents: systems that
execute tasks (triaged service, lead qualification, document classification).

Clinic with integrated scheduling and patient history: AI agent predicts which patients are most
likely not to show up, suggests automatic rescheduling for slots with waiting list, and generates
weekly reports with trends per specialty. All without analyst, without internal data scientist.

We don't do demo AI. We deploy when there's measurable ROI and data that supports the case. When the
use case isn't ready yet, we're honest and indicate the previous steps first: diagnostic,
integration, automation.

Ideal for companies that already organized their data (ideally went through diagnostic, integration
and automation) and want the next level of efficiency.

Each service can be contracted separately or in sequence. You don't need to start from scratch nor
buy everything at once.
The journey is progressive because every company is at a different moment.

**It's the lack of a thread connecting them.**

AvantiCoreX solves exactly that.

[Recognize this scenario? Let's talk.][11]

How it works

## A journey from chaos to autopilot. At your own pace.

Before flying a fighter jet, you need the flight plan. AvantiCoreX guides every step, from
preparation to autopilot.

**You are the hero of this story.**

You built a business, hired a team and chose tools to help it grow. The problem is that those tools
grew in different directions, and no one connected them.

AvantiCoreX is not just another tool. We are the guide that helps you connect everything, automate
what is repetitive and build the foundation for AI to work for you.

The journey has five steps. You can start at any of them.

01

Flight Plan

1 to 2 weeks

### Operational Diagnostic

First, we understand where you are.

We map your systems, processes and bottlenecks. We identify where time is lost, where data gets
stuck and where the company is leaving money on the table.

Result:

A clear plan of where to start, without jargon, without endless proposals.

02

Terrain Recon

### System Integration

We connect what you already have.

Before buying anything new, we look at what already works. If your scheduling system can talk to
finance, we connect them. If there's duplicated data in three places, we unify it.

Result:

Data that flows automatically between your existing systems.

03

Aircraft Preparation

### ERP when needed

If a system needs to be replaced, we deploy the right one.

When integration is not enough, because the system is too old, too expensive or too limited, we
deploy a management platform built on top of one of the world's largest enterprise platforms, with
thousands of modules available. Main ones include finance, inventory, CRM, projects, HR, procurement
and sales, configured and customized to your business needs. Cloud-based. No infrastructure to
manage.

Result:

A solid, unified data foundation accessible from anywhere.

04

Takeoff

### Process Automation

We eliminate repetitive work.

With organized data, we identify what can run on its own: approvals, notifications, reports, syncs,
follow-ups. Each automated task is an hour returned to your team.

Result:

Less rework, fewer human errors, more time for what matters.

05

Autopilot

### Artificial Intelligence Agents

Now AI enters the scene, with data ready for it to work on.

With integrated systems and reliable data, you can use AI for real: predictive analytics, agents
answering customers, dashboards generating automatic insights, demand forecasts, financial risk
identification. Not demo AI. AI that works in your business, every day.

Result:

A company that runs on autopilot, where you decide where to focus.

[Book a Diagnostic][12]

You choose where to start. We can begin with integration only, ERP only, or automation. The journey
is progressive, not all-or-nothing.

What we offer

## Choose where to start. Scale at your pace.

Five services. One coherent journey. You decide the next step.

01

### Operational Diagnostic

Find out exactly where your company loses time and money, before investing in any solution.

Show summary
[Learn more][13]

Complete mapping of current systems and how they (don't) talk. Identification of the main
operational bottlenecks measured in hours/week and currency/month. Process analysis: which are
manual, which are already automated, which should be.

Imagine an operation with scheduling in one system, finance in another, and reports consolidated in
spreadsheets. The diagnostic maps where the team spends time on rework, quantifies the cost and
indicates which area to fix first.

The diagnostic becomes an executable plan: you decide whether to contract the next steps with us or
run it internally. No lock-in, no proposal packaged before understanding your scenario.

Ideal for SMBs of 5 to 50 employees that know they lose time and money on rework, but don't know
where to start solving it.

02

### System Integration

Your existing systems start talking to each other, no double data entry, no manual typing.

Show summary
[Learn more][14]

Mapping of systems to integrate and the data that needs to flow between them. Connection via
official APIs when available (absolute preference). Robotic process automation (RPA) when the system
has no API.

Customer places an order on the e-commerce, the financial system issues the invoice automatically,
inventory updates, the team gets notified on WhatsApp and the daily report consolidates everything.
No human intervention, no double entry, no parallel control spreadsheet.

We integrate with what's available in your current scenario, we don't force a proprietary stack. If
the system has API, we connect via API. If not, we evaluate RPA. If switching makes more sense, we
say so, without commercial bias.

Ideal for SMBs that already have systems running but lose time typing the same data in more than one
place.

03

### Cloud ERP

A complete management platform, in the cloud, configured for your sector, no infrastructure cost.

Show summary
[Learn more][15]

Deployment of main modules: finance, inventory, CRM, HR, procurement, sales, projects. Customization
for your vertical (healthcare, services, retail, legal, accounting). Data migration from existing
systems trying to preserve relevant history.

Imagine an operation with several systems in use, spreadsheets controlling critical processes and
reports consolidated manually every week. In a typical deployment, scheduling, finance, billing and
reports come to live in a single platform, with business KPIs visible in a dashboard.

We don't sell licenses that become your problem. We deploy, configure, train and accompany during
operation. When the ERP needs to evolve, you don't get stuck: our team knows your specific
configuration.

Ideal for SMBs with fragile or outdated systems, critical spreadsheets controlling processes, or an
under-utilized enterprise ERP that weighs more than it delivers.

04

### Process Automation

Repetitive tasks run themselves. Your team focuses on what no machine can do.

Show summary
[Learn more][16]

Mapping of repetitive processes with the highest team time consumption. Design of automated flows
(who does what, in what order, with what rules). Implementation of workflows (BPM, RPA or code,
depending on the case).

Customer pays an invoice → bank system detects → ERP marks invoice as paid → CRM updates customer
stage → sales team gets WhatsApp notification → daily collection report updates → thank-you email to
the customer. All automatic, in seconds, with no one typing anything.

We automate first what gives the highest return. The operational diagnostic already lists the
processes with the most impact. We don't sell volume of automations: we sell the ones that pay back
fastest.

Ideal for SMBs that already have reasonably organized systems and want to eliminate repetitive
operational work.

05

### AI Agents

AI that actually works in your business, because your data is ready for it.

Show summary
[Learn more][17]

Data readiness assessment (without organized data, AI has no foundation). Predictive analytics:
demand forecasting, financial risk, customer churn, inventory rupture. AI agents: systems that
execute tasks (triaged service, lead qualification, document classification).

Clinic with integrated scheduling and patient history: AI agent predicts which patients are most
likely not to show up, suggests automatic rescheduling for slots with waiting list, and generates
weekly reports with trends per specialty. All without analyst, without internal data scientist.

We don't do demo AI. We deploy when there's measurable ROI and data that supports the case. When the
use case isn't ready yet, we're honest and indicate the previous steps first: diagnostic,
integration, automation.

Ideal for companies that already organized their data (ideally went through diagnostic, integration
and automation) and want the next level of efficiency.

Each service can be contracted separately or in sequence. You don't need to start from scratch nor
buy everything at once.
The journey is progressive because every company is at a different moment.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

[Damian Seeto]

Damian Seeto

Gaming Contributor

Damian has been contributing for Techday since 2009 and is always available whenever a video game
needs to be reviewed. Aside from being a big gamer, he is also one of biggest professional wrestling

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

[Damian Seeto]

Damian Seeto

Gaming Contributor

Damian has been contributing for Techday since 2009 and is always available whenever a video game
needs to be reviewed. Aside from being a big gamer, he is also one of biggest professional wrestling
fans. Damian likes Star Wars, comic book movies and Metallica.

## Horiba Yumizen C1200

### Reagents & Consumables

Cost-Effective alternative to the EOM line, endorsed for our almost 20 years in manufacturing

## Beckman DXC500AU & DXC700AU

### Reagents & Consumables

Now offering a full range of consumables for Beckman DXC500 & Beckman DXC700AU Chemistry
Instrumentation. Drop-In Replacement Items such as Reagents, Electrodes, Hardware & Consumables
Available.

LEARN MORE +
[Beckman DXC500AU & DXC700AU Reagents & Consumables]

## Toxicology Reagents & Consumables

### Now offered!

Mission Diagnostics is the pioneer and clear global leader in the manufacture and supply of high
quality, innovative consumables for the modern laboratory.

LEARN MORE +
[Toxicology Reagents & Consumables now offered]
[Slide Background]

## Down-To-Frame^{®}

### World Leader in Refurbished Instrumentation

The trademark Down-To-Frame process at Diamond refers to the quality, New Life of reconditioned
instrumentation. Since 2006, Diamond been certified to both ISO 9001 & 13485 and in November 2017
received upgrades to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 standards.

LEARN MORE +WATCH VIDEO +
[Down-To-Frame]
[Slide Background]

## Lab Services & Support

### Maintenance and repair services for lab instruments and equipment

Diamond Diagnostics is pleased to offer laboratories in the United States, Canada and the European
Union several service options to make the acquisition of refurbished instrumentation seamless while
offering existing instrumentation in your laboratory more cost-effective service arrangements.

LEARN MORE +WATCH VIDEO +
[Field Services]
[Depot Service][Preventive Maintenance][Remote Support][Control Assay][Refurbishment]
[Slide Background]

## SmartLyte^{®} Plus

### The Most Advanced Electrolyte Analyzer

New Autoloader Option Added

The Diamond Diagnostics SmartLyte PLUS Electrolyte Analyzer now offers an autoloader option. Save
time and resources with the ability to run 24 samples with minimal user interaction. Measured
results processed in <40 seconds to deliver fast, high-quality results. Measuring Na+, K+, Cl-, Ca++
and Li+ in whole blood, serum, plasma and urine utilizing Ion Selective Electrode (ISE) Technology.

LEARN MORE +WATCH VIDEO +
[SmartLyte Plus]
[Slide Background]

[Sysmex][Ortho][Cepheid][Abbott]
[Instrumentation][Coulter][Thermo][Siemens]
[Slide Background]

## ProLyte^{®}

### The World's Most Popular Electrolyte Analyzer

The Diamond ProLyte was uniquely designed with the user in mind. With the 4” touch screen display or
USB keyboard, easily navigate menus, search patient results, run on-screen diagnostics and access
data remotely. Additional benefits include 45 second analysis time, online support interface and
storage of 50,000+ results.

LEARN MORE +WATCH VIDEO +
[ProLyte]
[Slide Background]

## Unity^{®}

### Integrated Electrolyte System

The Diamond Diagnostics Unity Integrated Electrolyte System is a fast and compact ISE module
measuring Na+, K+ and Cl- within Serum, Plasma and Diluted Urine utilizing Ion Selective Electrode
(ISE) technology.

LEARN MORE +WATCH VIDEO +
[Unity]
[Slide Background]

## Contract Manufacturing

### Offering OEM and high volume manufacturing for companies around the world

With nearly 20 years of manufacturing experience, Diamond offers a contract for reconditioning and
manufacturing services for small and large organizations, as well as for manufacturers of
instruments and consumables worldwide.

LEARN MORE +

Jul 25 2026

The July 24 votes exposed a divide over whether listing unapproved peptides would improve patient
safety by moving their use into regulated pharmacies or give legitimacy to products supported by
limited evidence.

Jul 24 2026

Jul 24 2026

like-for-like and helping offset continued weakness in Taste & Wellbeing.

Jul 24 2026

to cost pressures for an industry reeling from the Iran war, risking more product discontinuations
or portfolio restructuring. Will exemptions be negotiated?

Jul 21 2026

China's pharma leverage goes beyond KSMs all the way up the value chain to biologics, trials, and
synthetic DNA. The US and India face a supply chain reckoning and experts fear ‘deniable disruption’
over an outright embargo while ‘informal-choke toolkits’ are also seen being formalized.

[[Clinical Data The Latest Front As Congress Moves To Counter China’s Growing Pharma Clout ]][34]

## [Clinical Data The Latest Front As Congress Moves To Counter China’s Growing Pharma Clout ][35]

Jul 09 2026

House appropriators argued China's faster clinical trial system, combined with limited FDA
oversight, creates patient safety and national security risks.

#### Physician Resources

We proudly provide our physicians with all of the latest tools to help our patients.

## Don’t want the expensive equipment bills?

#### Doctors who don’t have to bear the equipment costs for ultrasound and EMG (Electromyography)
#### gain several advantages:
1. Reduced Financial Burden: Not investing in expensive equipment helps doctors avoid significant
   upfront costs, maintenance expenses, and regular upgrades, allowing them to allocate resources
   elsewhere in their practice.
2. Access to Advanced Technology: By partnering with clinics or facilities that provide these tools,
   doctors can access state-of-the-art equipment without the financial commitment, ensuring they can
   offer their patients the latest diagnostic capabilities.
3. Flexibility and Convenience: Without the responsibility of maintaining the equipment, doctors
   have more flexibility in their practice, eliminating the need for dedicated space, staff
   training, and handling logistics related to the upkeep of these specialized machines.
4. Focus on Patient Care: With less administrative and financial burden related to equipment
   management, doctors can concentrate more on patient care, diagnosis, and treatment plans.
5. Cost-Efficiency: By paying for these services only when needed, doctors can potentially save
   money compared to owning the equipment outright, especially if they don’t use it frequently.

Overall, it allows doctors to maintain a high standard of care without the overhead costs and
logistical challenges associated with owning specialized medical equipment.

[About Us][10]

## Integrate Diagnostics services for your patients

[Patient use bioresonance therapy]

## Nerve Testing

Diagnostic nerve testing involves various procedures to assess the function and health of nerves in
the body. Common tests include electromyography (EMG) to evaluate muscle activity and nerve
conduction studies (NCS) to assess the speed of nerve signals. These tests help diagnose conditions
such as carpal tunnel syndrome, peripheral neuropathy, and nerve injuries. Keep in mind that
specific tests may vary based on the suspected nerve-related issue.

[Doctor conducting ultrasound examination]

## Ultrasound Testing

Diagnostic musculoskeletal ultrasound is a specialized application of ultrasound technology focused
on imaging the muscles, tendons, ligaments, joints, and surrounding soft tissues in the body’s
musculoskeletal system.

At Integrate Diagnostics, we understand that physicians need reliable resources for testing services
to provide the best possible care for their patients. That’s why we are dedicated to being your
partner in imaging solutions. With our state-of-the-art equipment and expertise, we offer a wide

you make accurate diagnoses and provide exceptional care. Trust Integrate Diagnostics to simplify
your patients’ diagnostic care and enhance their overall experience.

Your patients deserve the best, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Partner with
us for seamless and effective testing services. Welcome to Integrate Diagnostics, your trusted ally
in imaging solutions.

## Welcome to Integral Diagnostics (ASX:IDX)

**A leading provider of medical imaging services across Australia and New Zealand.**

Integral Diagnostics (IDX) provides state of the art diagnostic services to patients and their
referrers across Australia and New Zealand.

IDX employs some of Australasia’s leading radiologists and diagnostic imaging specialists in a
unique medical leadership model that ensures quality patient care, service, and access.

[Download Career Brochure][36]

**IDX offers unique opportunities to work in some of the most beautiful parts of Australia and New
Zealand.**

With locations in Queensland, Victoria, Western Australia, Northern NSW and Auckland, IDX can offer
a location that fits your lifestyle. Whether you want to live and work in a bustling CBD or prefer
the white sands and crystal waters of beach life, or even picturesque countryside in more regional
areas, IDX has an option for you.

### Acknowledgement of Country

Integral Diagnostics (IDX) acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the First
Peoples of Australia. We proudly recognise Elders past and present as the Traditional Owners of the
lands on which we work and live.

We are committed to supporting Indigenous self-determination and envision a future where all
Australians embrace Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander histories, cultures, and rights as a
central part of our Australian identity.

IDX recognises the status of Māori as Tangata Whenua and embraces the guiding principles of Te
Tiriti o Waitangi. We seek to grow our understanding of Kaupapa Māori, Tikanga Māori and Te Ao Māori
in order to uphold our Te Tiriti responsibilities.

### Integrated Holding Co.

## Success driven by Quality Performance

INTEGRATED HOLDING COMPANY was established in 2005. Because of the great experience of its
professional staff and management association with its international partners, IHC has made
remarkable progress in a short time.

INTEGRATED Group of companies provides unique specialized services to various vital industries in
the MENA region, particularly in the fields of oilfields, and energy and infrastructure projects.

INTEGRATED has a wide range of the latest Equipment meeting the needs of our customers. Today, we
are proud to be the best mobile crane rental business in the MENA region and the fourth in the world
(Crane Today Magazine June 2011)

### Integrated Holding Co.

## Success driven by Quality Performance

INTEGRATED HOLDING COMPANY was established in 2005. Because of the great experience of its
professional staff and management association with its international partners, IHC has made
remarkable progress in a short time.

INTEGRATED Group of companies provides unique specialized services to various vital industries in
the MENA region, particularly in the fields of oilfields, and energy and infrastructure projects.

INTEGRATED has a wide range of the latest Equipment meeting the needs of our customers. Today, we
are proud to be the best mobile crane rental business in the MENA region and the fourth in the world
(Crane Today Magazine June 2011)

## **Overview**

INTEGRATED® is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) based in Houston, Texas USA. From it’s
beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and engineer
industry standard pressure and flow control equipment that is utilized in the drilling and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas industry worldwide.

INTEGRATED® “State of the Art” manufacturing plants (Capital Equipment and Elastomers) are fully API
licensed facilities that operate as per our certified API / DNV Quality Management Systems (QMS)
processes. These facilities manufacture our OEM and Aftermarket products.

INTEGRATED® products are utilized worldwide by Land &  Platform Drilling Contractors, Well Service
Companies (including Snubbing), Rental Tool Companies, Completion Companies, major and independent
Energy Companies and are distributed globally through either INTEGRATED facility, Authorized
Licensed Repair Facilities (ARLF) or territorial partnerships.

## **Overview**

INTEGRATED® is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) based in Houston, Texas USA. From it’s
beginning in 2002, INTEGRATED manufacturing philosophy has been to develop, design and engineer
industry standard pressure and flow control equipment that is utilized in the drilling and
production sectors of the Oil & Gas industry worldwide.

INTEGRATED® “State of the Art” manufacturing plants (Capital Equipment and Elastomers) are fully API
licensed facilities that operate as per our certified API / DNV Quality Management Systems (QMS)
processes. These facilities manufacture our OEM and Aftermarket products.

INTEGRATED® products are utilized worldwide by Land &  Platform Drilling Contractors, Well Service
Companies (including Snubbing), Rental Tool Companies, Completion Companies, major and independent
Energy Companies and are distributed globally through either INTEGRATED facility, Authorized
Licensed Repair Facilities (ARLF) or territorial partnerships.

billing, in one place.

# We revolutionise diagnostics of allergies and food intolerances

[ For Distributors ][12] [ For Laboratories ][13] [ For Doctors ][14]

#### For laboratories, doctors and clinics

As scientists we offer future-oriented, intuitive immunodiagnostic all-in-one solutions on a
molecular basis, thus establishing a new gold standard in the interest of all stakeholders.

##### Big data approach

Our products and services continuously exchange and analyse data. This cloud-based solution ensures
seamless connectivity between all building blocks, driving constant improvement.

##### One-Fits-All

A complete solution: Our product range and systems can cover all our customers' needs for molecular
diagnostics of IgE-based allergies and IgG-mediated food intolerances.

##### Molecular Specificity

We offer the most comprehensive panel of molecular allergens (218) on one array. This makes our
allergy test unique and increases specificity compared to using allergen extracts alone.

### This is MADx

Get a better feel for what our company is all about! We are a multidisciplinary team of experts
working on one common goal: to improve and revolutionise immunodiagnostics!

**Sit back, relax and enjoy a visual tour through our Vienna headquarter and meet our team!**

#### 300 ALLERGENS & 286 ANTIGENS

## IgE-mediated allergies & IgG-mediated food intolerances

Our products convince through innovation, easy handling, and reliability. The advantages of our
tests, systems, and software benefit the whole value chain - patients, doctors, hospitals, and
society.

[ Our scientific work ][15]

##### ALEX (Allergy Xplorer)

ALEX (Allergy Xplorer) was the first ELISA based in vitro multiplex allergy test allowing
simultaneous measurements of total IgE (tlgE) and specific IgE (slgE) against a wide range of
allergen extracts and molecular allergens.

Available Kits:

20 Arrays
50 Arrays
[ Order ALEX testkits ][16] [ Product details ][17]

##### FOX (Food Xplorer)

FOX (Food Xplorer) is an ELISA based multiplex food antigen test allowing the simultaneous
measurement specific IgG (slgG) against a wide range of food extracts and molecular food antigens.

Available Kits:

50 Arrays
[ Order FOX testkits ][18] [ Product details ][19]

##### MAX 45k

To better serve high-throughput laboratories we offer Multi Array Xplorer 45k (MAX 45k). This fully
automated batch analyser is capable to process up to 50 samples in one run. MAX 45k is also a
benchtop device which operates in collaboration with MADx’s RAPTOR SERVER analysis software. In one
day, 150 samples can be processed (incl. overnight run).

Includes

[ Order MAX 45k ][20] [ Product details ][21]

##### ImageXplorer

For laboratories with a lower through-put and little lab space, ImageXplorer is a suitable choice.
This cost-effective system has a very low footprint (approx. 0.5 m², without PC/Laptop). The maximum
number of samples per run is 96 MADx tests per working day. ImageXplorer comes along with a lab
rocker, two array holders and an incubation chamber.

Includes

[ Order ImageXplorer ][22] [ Product details ][23]
[MADx-Wespe_9908_WEB-large]

#### our beginnings

## How it all started

In the beginning there was a vision to improve and modernize immunodiagnostics. Scientists - like
our founder Christian Harwanegg - always strive for disruptive innovation, so after more than a
decade with leading companies in the field he decided to start his own enterprise in 2016. Our goal
was clear: The newly founded company MADx (MacroArray Diagnostics) offers an allergy test that is
supposed to be better, more efficient and easier to use than the ones of the competition. In
addition, we wanted to offer the entire value chain from test material to evaluation, the necessary
hardware and software to the cloud-based interpretation software RAVEN that always runs in real
time.

[ More on MADx ][24]

##### Ever heard about sugar-free allergy diagnostics?

In nature, there are proteins in various pollen, fruits, cereals, nuts, spices, and insect venoms
that contain sugar structures that can be recognised by the human immune system as foreign and may
elicit the production of IgE antibodies.

she had to vomit and suffered from diarrhoea.

### XF16-80mmF4 R OIS WR

### One Lens, More Possibilities

Perfect for stills and video use, this compact standard zoom is a highly versatile optic that will

# Through-barrier well diagnostics

Superior diagnostics is the key to efficient oil and gas operations, minimizing environmental
footprint and enabling the transition to a fully decarbonized economy of the future.
We innovate, produce, and deploy technologies that provide intelligence and actionable insights
about the subsurface – in oil and gas reservoirs, by looking beyond a well’s barriers.

**Specialized in:**

## Flow behind casing diagnostics

## Well integrity diagnostics services

## Downhole acoustic diagnostics

## Integrated well diagnostics platform

## Sustained casing pressure diagnostics

## Cased-hole reservoir diagnostics

## A solution that serves YOU

With our bespoke consultancy and tailored diagnostics, we help you determine the best-fit solution
specific to your challenges.
[Video Thumbnail]

## Smarter decisions, longer asset life, cleaner future

With precise data on fluid movement, casing conditions, and cement & packer integrity, we empower
you to ensure optimized flow and an integral wellbore system – helping you achieve your
sustainability ambitions.

We are dedicated to comprehensively understand the complex fluid flow pathways within reservoirs and
wellbores throughout the asset’s entire life cycle – from commissioning and production to
abandonment.

In producing assets, an understanding of flow pathways in the formation in both producer and
injector wells leads to actionable decisions that significantly enhance well and reservoir
performance.

While abandoning an asset, it is key to assess the well system’s integrity to ensure that it is safe
to plug its wells according to best practices and regulatory requirements.

## A committed and agile journey

Driving environmental stewardship through innovative, risk-mitigating solutions. The four pillars of
our services - Reservoir Performance, Integrity & Sustainability, Digital Solutions,and Consulting
and Advisory Services – guide our innovation and diagnostics.

#### [Radiology][26]

## [Radiology] Radiology

Diagnostic Radiology is the branch of medicine consisting of non-invasive technology to create
images of the bones, tissues, and organs within the human body. The use of such images is evaluated
with the help of a radiologist or nuclear medicine physician to identify or monitor diseases or
injuries, through which the results further include a written report to the referring doctor. This
would include X-rays, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasounds,
nuclear medicine, positron emission tomography (PET), and more.

[Read More][27]

#### [Pathology][28]

## [Pathology] Pathology

Pathology tests help us with an understanding of the branch of medicine that is needed to treat a
specific disease, without which you would not be able to get the right medication. At Truecheck
Diagnostics, we comprise a team of experienced and qualified experts, who will provide you with the
best Pathology services leaving behind all. Our dedication goes a long way in providing a sound
researched program that includes a huge amount of data to be gathered, prepared, evaluated, and
rendered to meet your development goals.

[Read More][29]

#### [Health Check-Ups][30]

## [Health Check-UPs] Health Check-UPs

With a wide range of health check-ups in different clinical tests, we provide you with a way to
assess these check-ups for the best of your health needs. These health checkups will include a
physical examination ultrasound and as well as laboratory investigations that work on the evaluation
of your health in terms of your vital organs and metabolism to find early symptoms of any disease.
For the best of health-check ups services, we combined a full range of our diagnostic tests with the
most comprehensive packages.

[Read More][31]

#### [Cardiology][32]

## [Cardiology] Cardiology

We offer a distinct approach to the art of cardio-­vascular medicine. When you have a heart condition
or a heart disease, you don’t need to add any more stress. So it’s critical to know you’re in
capable, caring hands. Whether you have had a heart attack, suffer from atrial fibrillation (AFib),
or just need assistance controlling your cholesterol, our heart specialist will ensure that every
part of your care is managed for the greatest possible efficiency and effectiveness. We use the most
up-to-date cardiovascular technology and techniques, which are usually only available at university
hospitals. We ensure that your treatment is both comfortable and progressive.

[Read More][33]

[CT Scan - Truecheck Diagnostics]

## About Truecheck

A comprehensive healthcare center that gives you access to the best Diagnostic Medical Imaging
services.
We aim to make the world a better place by introducing life-changing health technologies to people
who need them most.
We deliver exceptional quality imaging with laser-sharp information that includes high-quality
diagnostic imaging tests.
We are committed to excellence in the delivery of medical services to doctors and patients alike.
This excellence is reflected in every aspect of our company, including our medical leadership and
people-focused ethos that values our staff as our most worthy asset.

[Read More][34]

# **Why Choose Truecheck Diagnostics?**

With Trucheck diagnostics, you get the best results because of our balanced approach combining
empathy and expertise. Here are some of the tenets that help us deliver care through precision:

### **Perpetual Leadership**

Our commitment to becoming an advanced diagnostics service provider, and being at the forefront of
increasingly complex practices, ensures that we stay up-to-date with the latest advancements and
expertise. This, in turn, strengthens the diagnostic capabilities, giving you the benefit of
reliable and effective medical services.

### **Experience & Expertise**

We are led by medical professionals who have many years of experience within the healthcare sector
and make decisions that are focused on optimal clinical and patient outcomes. You can rest assured,
knowing our teams of highly experienced radiologists, technicians, and nurses are working tirelessly
to give you the best experience.

injuries, through which the results further include a written report to the referring doctor. This
would include X-rays, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasounds,
nuclear medicine, positron emission tomography (PET), and more.

##  COMMON BURSARY QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS

### WHO QUALIFIED FOR A BURSARY?

The requirements are different for each bursary programme, and those requirements will be specified
in each bursary listing, but here are some common requirements that are seen across most bursary
programmes:
* You must be a South African citizen (some bursaries even fund South African permanent residents)
* You must be either in Matric or have completed Matric
* You must have a strong academic record (in Matric and at tertiary level if currently studying) –
  depending on your field of study, you may also be required to show strong academic results in
  Mathematics, Science or languages
* You must be studying or have applied to study at a recognized tertiary institution in South Africa
  (including public and private institutes – TVET colleges, Universities and Universities of
  Technology)
* You must be studying or have applied to study for full time studies (part time studies and
  correspondence studies are sometimes also funded but most bursaries only cover full time studies)
* You must be able to prove financial need

**[Read more common bursary FAQ’s here][77]**

### HOW CAN I APPLY FOR A BURSARY?

On each bursary listing, you will see instructions on how to apply for the specific bursary
programme. Some bursaries have an online bursary application, while others require students to
download an application form, which will then be submitted via email, fax, post or hand delivery.

Students are always required to submit supporting documentation when applying, and this may include
(but is not limited to):
* A certified copy of your South African ID document (or South African permanent residence if
  applicable)
* A certified copy of your academic records (Matric latest results if currently in Matric, Matric
  certificate if completed Matric, full academic record if currently studying at tertiary level)
* Proof of tertiary application, registration or acceptance (on the institutions letterhead)
* A motivational letter explaining why you should be selected for the bursary award
* Proof of household income showing financial need (this will include your parents/ guardians proof
  of income or proof of unemployment)
* Proof of residence – this only applies if the bursary specifies that it only covers students
  residing in a certain region

### WHAT EXPENSES OR FEES DOES A BURSARY COVER?

Bursaries can be either partial or full. A partial bursary means only a certain amount or portion of
your study-related expenses will be covered, while full-cover bursaries usually cover all study
related expenses, including: tuition fees, examination fees, prescribed books and study materials,
meals, accommodation, transport and sometime a laptop.

Some bursary providers also allow students to complete vacation work at the company, which is
required for some degree qualifications.

**[Read more about which expenses bursaries cover here][78]**

### DO I HAVE TO PAY BACK A BURSARY?

No – bursary recipients will NOT be required to pay back their bursary.
Some bursary providers require students to work for their company after graduation, for an equal
duration of time as funding received. This is beneficial to both the bursary provider and the
bursary recipient, as the student has guaranteed employment after completion of their studies and
the chance to gain invaluable work experience.

### HOW DO I KNOW IF A BURSARY IS LEGIT OR A SCAM?

At SA Bursaries, we aim to ensure that every bursary we publish is legitimate. If you are ever asked
to pay money to submit a bursary application, this is an indication that the bursary is not
legitimate. If the bursary application requires you to send your application forms and documents to
a free email account (ie gmail, yahoo, hotmail etc), then it is likely a scam – application emails
will always be required to be sent to the companies official email addresses. If you ever have any
concern that a bursary could be a scam, please let us know so that we can further investigate this.

### WHERE CAN I FIND BURSARIES FOR THE 2027 ACADEMIC YEAR? 

To apply for a bursary for the 2027 academic year, please scroll up this page until you find your
field of study, see which bursaries are open for your field and follow the detailed instructions to
apply.

Please note that you can apply for as many bursaries as you qualify for.
Students can also visit the **[All bursaries currently open for application][79]** section.

bursaries closing soon on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.**

## ABOUT SA BURSARIES

Welcome to SA Bursaries, South Africa’s largest bursary website – a platform with the most
comprehensive list of **bursaries in South Africa**, updated regularly. Our goal is to find as many
bursary opportunities as possible throughout South Africa, and publish it all on one platform, to
make them easily accessible for students.

If you are looking to further your studies but lack the funding to do so, and you have a strong
academic history which you have maintained throughout the year, you may be eligible to apply for a
bursary.

Bursaries are awarded to students currently in Matric and who will be studying at University or
College the following year, as well as current tertiary student who cannot afford to continue paying
for their studies.

##  COMMON BURSARY QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS

### WHO QUALIFIED FOR A BURSARY?

The requirements are different for each bursary programme, and those requirements will be specified
in each bursary listing, but here are some common requirements that are seen across most bursary
programmes:
* You must be a South African citizen (some bursaries even fund South African permanent residents)
* You must be either in Matric or have completed Matric
* You must have a strong academic record (in Matric and at tertiary level if currently studying) –
  depending on your field of study, you may also be required to show strong academic results in
  Mathematics, Science or languages
* You must be studying or have applied to study at a recognized tertiary institution in South Africa
  (including public and private institutes – TVET colleges, Universities and Universities of
  Technology)
* You must be studying or have applied to study for full time studies (part time studies and
  correspondence studies are sometimes also funded but most bursaries only cover full time studies)
* You must be able to prove financial need

**[Read more common bursary FAQ’s here][77]**

### HOW CAN I APPLY FOR A BURSARY?

On each bursary listing, you will see instructions on how to apply for the specific bursary
programme. Some bursaries have an online bursary application, while others require students to
download an application form, which will then be submitted via email, fax, post or hand delivery.

Students are always required to submit supporting documentation when applying, and this may include
(but is not limited to):
* A certified copy of your South African ID document (or South African permanent residence if
  applicable)
* A certified copy of your academic records (Matric latest results if currently in Matric, Matric
  certificate if completed Matric, full academic record if currently studying at tertiary level)
* Proof of tertiary application, registration or acceptance (on the institutions letterhead)
* A motivational letter explaining why you should be selected for the bursary award
* Proof of household income showing financial need (this will include your parents/ guardians proof
  of income or proof of unemployment)
* Proof of residence – this only applies if the bursary specifies that it only covers students
  residing in a certain region

### WHAT EXPENSES OR FEES DOES A BURSARY COVER?

Bursaries can be either partial or full. A partial bursary means only a certain amount or portion of
your study-related expenses will be covered, while full-cover bursaries usually cover all study
related expenses, including: tuition fees, examination fees, prescribed books and study materials,
meals, accommodation, transport and sometime a laptop.

Some bursary providers also allow students to complete vacation work at the company, which is
required for some degree qualifications.

**[Read more about which expenses bursaries cover here][78]**

### DO I HAVE TO PAY BACK A BURSARY?

No – bursary recipients will NOT be required to pay back their bursary.
Some bursary providers require students to work for their company after graduation, for an equal
duration of time as funding received. This is beneficial to both the bursary provider and the
bursary recipient, as the student has guaranteed employment after completion of their studies and
the chance to gain invaluable work experience.

### HOW DO I KNOW IF A BURSARY IS LEGIT OR A SCAM?

At SA Bursaries, we aim to ensure that every bursary we publish is legitimate. If you are ever asked
to pay money to submit a bursary application, this is an indication that the bursary is not
legitimate. If the bursary application requires you to send your application forms and documents to
a free email account (ie gmail, yahoo, hotmail etc), then it is likely a scam – application emails
will always be required to be sent to the companies official email addresses. If you ever have any
concern that a bursary could be a scam, please let us know so that we can further investigate this.
